name: Template: Simple Kanban
description: General-purpose kanban for any team. Each swimlane is a team or workstream; each card is a work item.

swimlanes.name: Frontend
swimlanes.notes: React + TypeScript. Owns all UI components, pages, and the design system.

swimlanes.name: Backend
swimlanes.notes: Django + DRF. Owns API, data models, business logic, and background tasks.

swimlanes.name: Mobile
swimlanes.notes: React Native. iOS + Android. Syncs with main API.

swimlanes.name: Design
swimlanes.notes: UX/UI design, design system, user research.

swimlanes.name: QA
swimlanes.notes: Manual and automated testing. Regression suites and exploratory testing.

swimlanes.name: Data
swimlanes.notes: Data engineering and analytics. Pipelines, dashboards, and reporting.

swimlanes.name: Security
swimlanes.notes: Application security, penetration testing, and compliance audits.

swimlanes.name: Platform
swimlanes.notes: Shared libraries, SDKs, developer tooling, and internal APIs.

swimlanes.name: Documentation
swimlanes.notes: Technical writing, API docs, user guides, and onboarding materials.

custom_fields.name: Sprint
custom_fields.help_text: Sprint the work is committed to.

custom_fields.name: Target date
custom_fields.help_text: Date someone outside the team is relying on.

swimlane_custom_fields.name: Cost center
swimlane_custom_fields.help_text: Finance cost center for the team. Admins only.
